title: MINER: Improving Out-of-Vocabulary Named Entity Recognition from an Information Theoretic Perspective
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving named entity recognition by addressing out-of-vocabulary (OOV) entities using an information-theoretic approach. It does not contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
